CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_ATTRIBUTES.TITLE: Appointment attributes
CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_ATTRIBUTES.DESCRIPTION: Create contact attributes in the Citas category and calculate their values from appointments. Existing appointments are filled in the background when you enable an attribute.
CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_ATTRIBUTES.DISABLE_HINT: Unchecking an attribute stops updates and keeps its definition and saved values. Dates are stored in UTC and displayed in your time zone.
CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_ATTRIBUTES.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load appointment attributes. Reload the page to try again.
CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_ATTRIBUTES.CONFLICT_DETAIL: Existing type: {actual}. Expected type: {expected}. The attribute and its values were left unchanged.

ultima_cita.NAME: Last appointment
ultima_cita.HELP: Start of the most recent appointment that has already started. Cancelled and deleted appointments are excluded.

proxima_cita.NAME: Next appointment
proxima_cita.HELP: Start of the nearest future appointment. Cancelled and deleted appointments are excluded.

proxima_cita_titulo.NAME: Next appointment title
proxima_cita_titulo.HELP: Title of the nearest future appointment. Cleared when there is no next appointment.

total_citas.NAME: Total appointments
total_citas.HELP: Number of past and future appointments linked to the contact, excluding cancelled and deleted appointments.
